soundtrack.music: Quirky, satisfying stop-motion pop: receipt-printer rhythms and paper tears as percussion, plucky marimba and pizzicato strings, a confident bass groove landing with a cash-register-style final ding. Around 112 BPM, clever and bright. No vocals.

receipt.title: BU HAFTA
